LESSON: LENGTH

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: MEASUREMENT Strand Sub strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Expe
Topic 2.1: Length
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Length, part of MEASUREMENT Strand Sub strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Expe in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do you compare the length of two objects? 2. What can be used to measure the length of the teacher’s table?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Collect objects in purposive groups/pairs of different lengths from the immediate environment. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to collect objects. Safety of all learners should be observed especially for learners with chronic health conditions.

2. Compare objects in purposive groups/pairs directly to identify objects

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Collect objects in purposive groups/pairs of different lengths from the immediate environment. Learners with manipulative difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body or assistive technology or be assisted by peers, learner support assistants or the teacher to collect objects. Safety of all learners should be observed especially for learners with chronic health conditions.
2. Compare objects in purposive groups/pairs directly to identify objects

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Length together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: learner measures lengths of different objects in their immediate environment.

• Communication and collaboration: learner discusses and measures lengths using arbitrary units.

Values:
Responsibility: learner takes care of objects collected from the environment for learning.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: learner works harmoniously in teams as they measure lengths using arbitrary units.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate concept of using objects from the environment for learning to the concept of resources in the

environment in Environmental Activities.
